title: Dependency Installation and Update
description: Core workflow: Developer installs, updates, or removes packages via install/update/require/remove commands, driving the full resolver-to-installer pipeline.
command_to_installer_flow: RequireCommand::execute() → updates composer.json → Installer::create() → setUpdate(true) → setInstall(true) → run() → doUpdate()
RemoveCommand::execute() → removes from composer.json → Installer::create() → setUpdate(true) → setInstall(true) → run() → doUpdate()
installer_run_flow: Installer::run() → doUpdate() OR doInstall() based on $update flag
doInstall() → installationManager.execute(repo, operations, devMode, runScripts, downloadOnly)
installation_manager_operations: InstallationManager::execute(repo, operations[]) — main entry point, batches operations
InstallationManager::getInstaller(type) — lookup installer by package type
downloadAndExecuteBatch() — parallel download via React Promises, then sequential install
key_relationships: InstallCommand, UpdateCommand, RequireCommand, RemoveCommand all extend BaseCommand
All commands create Installer via Installer::create($io, $composer)
Installer depends_on RepositoryManager, DownloadManager, InstallationManager, Locker, EventDispatcher, AutoloadGenerator
InstallationManager aggregates InstallerInterface implementations (LibraryInstaller, PluginInstaller, etc.)
InstallationManager uses DownloadManager (via FileDownloader) for package downloads
Installer delegates dependency solving to Solver (DependencyResolver)
Solver uses Pool (built by RepositorySet from RepositoryManager repositories)
Locker reads/writes composer.lock; Installer reads lock on install, writes lock on update
installer_flags: $update=true → run doUpdate (resolve + lock write) then doInstall
$install=false + $update=true → update lock only, skip package installs (composer update --no-install)
$dryRun=true → skip executeOperations, lock write, autoloader dump
$downloadOnly=true → skip autoloader dump, only download archives
important_notes: Installer::create() is a static factory — called by all install/update/require/remove commands
All download operations are async via React Promises (Loop/Promise concurrency)
Signal handling (SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP) triggers cleanup in InstallationManager::execute()
doUpdate() always calls doInstall(alreadySolved=true) at the end unless $install=false
Solver produces LocalRepoTransaction (install) or LockTransaction (update) — operations list fed to InstallationManager
